scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Go and train yourself in preparation for the holy war that is coming. Victory will be in the hands of those who are most ready to receive it.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
去磨練自己，為即將到來的聖戰做好準備。
勝利屬於準備最充分的人。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
We are Crusaders,
warriors preparing
to fight in the Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
我們是十字軍，是為迎戰聖戰而磨練自己的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah...
I see that you have been called to become a Crusader. We are assured of your will, but now we must test your capabilities.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
啊...
看來你已蒙召，註定要成為十字軍。
你的意志已得到認可，接下來還需考驗你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
We are Crusaders, warriors preparing for the Holy War.
What brings you
to this place?
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
我們是十字軍，是為聖戰做準備的戰士。
你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Have you proven your determination with the task I have given you, or do you possess the items proving that you have received your calling?
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
你是否完成了我交給你的任務，證明自己的決心？
或是帶來了能證明你已蒙召的物品？

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You haven't finished learning everything as a Swordsman. Use all of your remaining skill points, and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
你還沒有完成劍士的學習。
把剩餘的技能點全部用完，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Congratulations on completing all of your tests. You are truly worthy of fighting alongside side us in the Holy War as a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
恭喜你通過所有考驗。
你確實有資格成為十字軍，在聖戰中與我們並肩作戰。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
It seems that you have not yet completed all of the testing. You will not be ready to become a Crusader until you have completed the tests set before you.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
看來你還沒完成所有考驗。
通過這些考驗後，你才能成為十字軍。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You don't belong here, my friend.
Be advised to continue practicing yourself.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
朋友，你不該來這裡。
還是繼續磨練自己吧。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Chaos will one day arise to challenge our principles of peace, justice and order. Until we have eliminated evil and created our ideal world, we must not cease training.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
總有一天，混亂會興起，挑戰我們堅守的和平、正義與秩序。
在消滅邪惡、創造理想世界之前，我們絕不能停止訓練。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you wish to join us, you must first learn the Swordsman discipline and train yourself thoroughly...
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
想加入我們，就先學好劍士的技藝，充分磨練自己...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
As it happened one thousand years ago, evil forces will one day attack in droves in an attempt to take over the world once again.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
邪惡勢力終有一天會像千年前那樣大舉來襲，妄圖再次掌控世界。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
穆爾納克·米茹爾正在普隆德拉王宮的地下城里訓練。
先去找他談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
穆爾納克和其他人會考驗你的能力極限，幫你找到自己的道路。
完成他們的考驗後，再回來找我...

scripts.text: I want to prepare for the Holy War!
scripts.translation: 我想為聖戰做準備！

scripts.text: Nothing in particular.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼特別的事

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You wish to become
a Crusader...?
Joining us is not as
easy as it sounds.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
你想成為十字軍...？
加入我們可沒那麼容易。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
I am Michael Halig. I am one of but many Crusaders preparing for the Holy War. We continuously train ourselves with sincere faith and endless loyalty.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
我是邁克爾·哈利格，是眾多為聖戰做準備的十字軍之一。
我們懷著虔誠的信仰和堅定不移的忠誠，不斷磨練自己。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
We recruit Swordsmen that express exceptional faith, or those who were born as warriors
by Odin's will.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
我們招募信仰堅定的劍士，以及遵循奧丁意志、天生為戰士的人。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Possessing the ^3355FFChivalry Emblem^000000 and ^3355FFHand of God^000000 is seen as a sign that you have been called to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
擁有^3355FF忠誠之證^000000和^3355FF神之手^000000，就被視為蒙召成為十字軍的標誌。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
After obtaining those items and passing our tests, you too, can become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
獲得這些物品並通過我們的考驗後，你也能成為十字軍。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
I don't know what type of person you are right now though. But
I shall test you if you desire. Are you willing to endure these tests in preparation for the Holy War?
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
我還不瞭解你是怎樣的人，不過只要你願意，我就會考驗你。
為了迎接聖戰，你願意接受這些考驗嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 我願意

scripts.text: I'd like to think about it.
scripts.translation: 我想再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Wait...
You're not ready yet.
You need to be at least
Job Level 40 to become
a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
等等...
你還沒準備好。
至少達到職業等級40，才能成為十字軍。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Train yourself more as a Swordsman and wait for your calling. I understand your intent, but as of now, you cannot join us.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
繼續以劍士的身份磨練自己，等待召喚吧。
我明白你的志向，不過現在還不能讓你加入。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You haven't finished learning everything as a Swordsman. Use all of your remaining skill points, and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
你還沒有完成劍士的學習。
把剩餘的技能點全部用完，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Then...
I shall test you to see if you are fit to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
那麼...
我會考驗你，看你是否有資格成為十字軍。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Your name is
{0}...?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
你的名字是 {0}...？
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah...
I see that you have been called to become a Crusader. We are assured of your will, but now we must test your capabilities.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
啊...
看來你已蒙召，註定要成為十字軍。
你的意志已得到認可，接下來還需考驗你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
穆爾納克·米茹爾正在普隆德拉王宮的地下城里訓練。
先去找他談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
穆爾納克和其他人會考驗你的能力極限，幫你找到自己的道路。
完成他們的考驗後，再回來找我...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Mmm. I can't discern whether or not you have the heart to become a Crusader. However, if you have the will and put forth the effort, you may have what it takes.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
嗯，我還看不出你是否有成為十字軍的決心。
不過，只要意志堅定、肯付出努力，你也許就有這份資質。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Now...
This is my test for you. Bring me the following items and prove your determination to me.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
現在...
這就是我給你的考驗。
帶來以下物品，向我證明你的決心。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Show me the strength of your will by gathering these items. If you prove successful, you will progress to the next test. May Odin protect you.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
收集這些物品，證明你的意志有多堅定。
完成後，就能接受下一項考驗。
願奧丁護佑你。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Nobody knows when the Holy War will come. We must prepare in advance and cannot afford to slacken
our training.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
沒人知道聖戰何時到來。
我們必須提前準備，訓練一刻也不能鬆懈。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you feel that participating in the Holy War is your calling, please come back right away and take the test to become
a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
如果你覺得參加聖戰是自己的使命，就儘快回來接受轉職十字軍的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you, too, are a man of the sword, constantly train and prepare yourself. No one knows when the Holy War may begin.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
既然你也是劍士，就要不斷磨練自己，做好準備。
沒人知道聖戰何時會開始。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
As a woman of the sword, you must train diligently and constantly. Prepare yourself, for no one knows when the Holy War may be coming.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
身為女劍士，你必須堅持勤奮訓練，做好準備。
沒人知道聖戰何時會到來。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah, well done.
I must acknowledge your efforts and determination. You may now proceed to take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
啊，做得好。
你的努力和決心已得到認可。
現在可以接受下一項考驗了。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
穆爾納克·米茹爾正在普隆德拉王宮的地下城里訓練。
先去找他談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
穆爾納克和其他人會考驗你的能力極限，幫你找到自己的道路。
完成他們的考驗後，再回來找我...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah, you still have not completed the task I have given to you. Bring me the following items, and prove your will to become a Crusader to me...
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
啊，你還沒完成我交給你的任務。
帶來以下物品，向我證明你成為十字軍的決心...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you put forth the effort, you'll be able to accomplish this task. May Odin protect you on your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
只要肯努力，就能完成這項任務。
願奧丁護佑你的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Together, let us ready ourselves and be victorious over evil and tyranny!
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
讓我們共同做好準備，戰勝邪惡與暴政！

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Behold...!
You are now a Crusader!
When the Holy War comes, we shall fight side by side against the forces of evil.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
看...！
你已經是十字軍了！
聖戰來臨時，我們將並肩對抗邪惡勢力。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Now you are
one of us!
...Brother.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
現在，你也是我們的一員了！
...兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Now you are
one of us!
...Comrade.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
現在，你也是我們的一員了！
...戰友。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
And use this in times of dire peril. It will give you strength when your wounds are most grievous.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
危急時就使用這個。
當你傷勢嚴重時，它會為你帶來力量。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Never forget that the Holy War is approaching. We must be prepare for the inevitable tide of evil that will sweep this world. Now, go forth and fight for the principles of freedom and justice!
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
別忘了，聖戰正在逼近。
邪惡的浪潮終將席捲世界，我們必須做好準備。
現在，出發吧，為自由與正義而戰！

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Return to me when you have completed all of your tests. When you finally prove eligible, you will join the proud ranks of the mighty Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[邁克爾·哈利格]
完成所有考驗後，再來找我。
當你證明自己的資格，就能加入強大而光榮的十字軍行列。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Don't linger around in a place like this and forge your own path towards discovering your own strengths. The day that we will join hands in battle will come soon.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
別在這種地方逗留，去開闢自己的道路，發掘自身的力量吧。
我們並肩作戰的日子很快就會到來。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
A Novice...?
So green, and yet,
so much potential.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
初心者...？
雖然稚嫩，卻有無限潛力。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hm. You have no business in a place like this. Please leave, and do not interrupt my training.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
嗯，這裡沒有你的事。
請離開，別打擾我的修行。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What do you want...?
If you have no business here,
then please leave. A tranquil state of mind is essential in self training...
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
你有什麼事...？
沒事的話，就請離開。
修行必須保持心境平和...

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What is it...?
Do you have business
with me, man of the sword?
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
怎麼了...？
劍士，你找我有事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What is it...?
Do you have business
with me, woman of the sword?
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
怎麼了...？
女劍士，你找我有事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What is it...?
You're the Swordman from before. What happened, did you fail?
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
怎麼了...？
是之前那位劍士啊。
沒通過考驗嗎？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmm, seems like you did well. It shouldn't have been too hard. You no longer have any business
with me.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
嗯，看來你做得不錯。
應該不算太難吧。
我這裡已經沒有你的事了。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmmm...
You still have tests to complete if you want to become a Crusader, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
嗯...
想成為十字軍，你還有其他考驗要完成，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Let me assure you that I'm no criminal. I'm here merely to train myself. Perhaps as you become stronger, you will understand.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
放心，我不是罪犯，只是在這裡修行。
等你變得更強，也許就會明白了。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
I wish to improve the sense of serenity in my heart in preparation for the Holy War that is to come. So please, do not disturb me.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
為了迎接聖戰，我正在修煉，讓內心更加平靜。
所以請別打擾我。

scripts.text: I'd like to take the Crusader test.
scripts.translation: 我想參加十字軍考核

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
You wish to become a Crusader...? Hm, fighting in the Holy War is an admirable goal we may both share.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
你想成為十字軍...？
嗯，為聖戰而戰是個崇高的目標，也許你我志向相同。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Your name is
{0}...?
Let me take
a look at your face.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
你的名字是 {0}...？
讓我看看你的臉。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmm. You wish to become a Crusader, but do not wear a Rosary? I have no business with you if you cannot uphold our customs.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
嗯，想成為十字軍，卻不佩戴念珠？
連我們的傳統都不遵守，我也沒什麼好跟你說的。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmm...
You seem so-so, but also young and ambitious. Ambition may work against you if it is not tempered with patience.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
嗯...
你看起來資質平平，不過年輕而有抱負。
沒有耐心約束，抱負也可能成為阻礙。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Don't give me a reason to doubt you, and show me your patience. You must endure my test with your patience if you wish to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
別讓我懷疑你，證明你的耐心吧。
想成為十字軍，就得耐心承受我的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
You may take my test right away. It's actually quite simple. All you must do is walk to the end of the corridor.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
現在就可以開始。
考驗很簡單，只要走到走廊盡頭就行。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
But...
You must keep one thing in mind. Under no condition are you allowed to kill the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
不過...
有一點必須記住：無論如何，都不許殺死魔物。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Well then...
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
那麼...
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
You seem to have a lot of time on your hands. Why don't you do something more productive, like pick Jellopy off the streets or something?
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
你似乎很閒啊。
不如做點有用的事，比如去街上撿些傑勒比結晶？

scripts.text: Let me retake the test.
scripts.translation: 讓我再考一次

scripts.text: What kind of test was that?!
scripts.translation: 這算什麼考驗？！

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
I'll let you retake the test as much as you like. But if you continuously fail, there's an inherent problem with your
state of mind.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
想重考多少次都可以。
不過，如果一直失敗，那就是心態有問題了。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Wait...
Where have you left your Rosary? You can't let that lie around just anywhere. We are supposed to be warriors of holiness.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
等等...
你把念珠放哪了？
可不能隨便亂放。
我們是神聖的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Carelessly losing things is an attitude for mere Swordsmen. If you really want to retake the test, you must respect the Crusader traditions.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
粗心大意、丟三落四，那是普通劍士的做派。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Your problem is your habit of hitting monsters the moment you see one. You must develop your patience and endurance.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
你的問題就是看見魔物就動手。
必須學會忍耐，磨練耐力。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Just focus...
Your only goal is to walk from one end of the corridor to the other. It's simple when you think
about it.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
專心一點...
你的目標只有一個，就是從走廊這頭走到那頭。
想清楚了，其實很簡單。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
No matter what you do, do not kill any of the monsters. This time, think carefully before you draw your sword.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]

這次拔劍之前，先想清楚。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Well then...
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[穆爾納克·米茹爾]
那麼...
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]

[穆爾納克·米茹爾]

[Murnak Mijoul]

[穆爾納克·米茹爾]

[Murnak Mijoul]

[Gabriel Valentine]
Welcome, I am a Crusader.
I am preparing for the
foretold Holy War
that is to come.

[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]

9. 治療術無法解除哪種狀態？

scripts.text: Curse
scripts.translation: 詛咒

scripts.text: Silence
scripts.translation: 沉默

scripts.text: Chaos
scripts.translation: 混亂

scripts.text: Blind
scripts.translation: 失明

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
10. What best describes a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
10. 下列哪項最能描述十字軍？

scripts.text: One preparing for matrimony.
scripts.translation: 準備結婚的人

scripts.text: One preparing for the Holy War.
scripts.translation: 為聖戰做準備的人

scripts.text: One preparing consummation.
scripts.translation: 準備圓房的人

scripts.text: One preparing potions.
scripts.translation: 準備藥劑的人

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Good work~
Well, first let me
look at your results.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
做得不錯~
讓我先看看你的成績。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Superb! Now, it's time for
you to take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
{0}的得分是{1}分...
太棒了！
現在可以接受下一項考驗了。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Well done~ Now, it's time for
you to take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
{0}的得分是{1}分...
做得很好~
現在可以接受下一項考驗了。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Seems like you prepared a lot so I'll let you pass this time.
Hurry now and go take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
{0}的得分是{1}分...
看得出你認真準備過，這次就讓你通過吧。
快去接受下一項考驗。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Hmmm... What a pity.
Go study some more and
take this test again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
{0}的得分是{1}分...
嗯...真可惜。
再多複習一些，然後回來重考，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Go to Prontera Castle
and meet Bliant Piyord.
I will inform him that
he will be testing you next.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
去普隆德拉王宮找布萊恩特·皮約德。
我會通知他，由他主持你的下一項考驗。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Go to Prontera Castle
and meet Bliant Piyord.
I will inform him that
he will be testing you next.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
去普隆德拉王宮找布萊恩特·皮約德。
我會通知他，由他主持你的下一項考驗。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Go to the Prontera Castle and meet Bliant Piyord.
I will inform him to prepare the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
去普隆德拉王宮找布萊恩特·皮約德。
我會通知他準備下一項考驗。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Don't stress, you need to know a lot in order to pass this test. In any case, I'll be waiting right here. When you think you're ready, come back, alright?
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
彆著急，這項考驗需要掌握不少知識才能通過。
我會在這裡等你。
準備好了再回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
You will soon join us in our preparations for the Holy War. Continue to live with faith after becoming a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
你很快就能加入我們，共同為聖戰做準備了。
成為十字軍後，也要始終堅守信仰。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Finish those other tests,
and come to me once you're
instructed. Until then,
I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾·瓦倫丁]
先完成其他考驗，等有人指引你來時再來找我。
那麼，回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
How goes
your training?
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
歡迎。
訓練進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
We are Crusaders,
warriors of holiness preparing for the great Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
歡迎。
我們是十字軍，是為即將到來的偉大聖戰做準備的神聖戰士。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
It's nice
to meet you.
It is now time
for your final test.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
歡迎。
很高興見到你。
現在該接受最後的考驗了。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
Are you prepared
for the test now?
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
歡迎。
現在準備好接受考驗了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
Congratulations.
You have completed
all the tests to
become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
歡迎。
恭喜，你已經完成了轉職十字軍所需的全部考驗。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
Are you not one of the ones in the process of becoming a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
歡迎。
你不是正在接受十字軍轉職考驗的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Develop your faith. From faith springs strength and discipline. Day after day, train yourself and become a great Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
堅定你的信仰。
力量與自律都源自信仰。
日復一日地磨練自己，成為出色的十字軍吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Are you interested
in becoming a Crusader?
We are always waiting
for more capable men and
women to join our ranks.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
想成為十字軍嗎？
我們隨時歡迎有能力的男女加入。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Train as a Swordsman and come to us when you think you are ready. If you have been called by Odin to become a Crusader, that would be even better.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
先以劍士的身份磨練自己，覺得準備好了再來找我們。
如果你已蒙奧丁召喚，註定成為十字軍，那就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Even in these relatively peaceful times, our training is ceaseless. We must be ready for the day with the tides of darkness shall rush against mankind...
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
即使如今還算和平，我們也從不停止訓練。
黑暗浪潮終將湧向人類，我們必須為那一天做好準備...

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Are you interested
in becoming a Crusader?
We are always waiting
for more capable men and
women to join our ranks.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
想成為十字軍嗎？
我們隨時歡迎有能力的男女加入。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
To become a Crusader, you must train until you are Job Level 40. For more details, please speak with our leader inside.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
想成為十字軍，必須先練到職業等級40。
詳情請去裡面找我們的首領瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
May Odin
be with you...
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
願奧丁與你同在...

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
My name is Bliant Piyord and I too, am preparing for the Holy War. It must've been quite a hassle to come all this way.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
我叫布萊恩特·皮約德，也在為聖戰做準備。
一路奔波到這裡，想必很辛苦吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
This test will gauge your skills in battle. Only those with great fighting ability can become Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
這項考驗會檢驗你的戰鬥技巧。
只有戰鬥能力出眾的人，才能成為十字軍。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
To take the battle test, bring
1 ^3355FFHoly Water^000000. This will be used to purify you prior to taking the test.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
參加實戰考核，需要帶來1瓶^3355FF聖水^000000。
考核前會用它為你淨化。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Well then...
Shall we
begin right away?
Or do you need time
to prepare yourself?
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
那麼...
現在就開始嗎？
還是需要些時間準備？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Would you like to begin now, or do you still need time to make preparations?
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
你想現在開始，還是還需要時間做準備？

scripts.text: I would like to begin.
scripts.translation: 我想開始

scripts.text: Give me some time to prepare.
scripts.translation: 給我一點時間準備

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Just a second, you do not have a Rosary equipped. As a Crusader, you must always have a Rosary on your person.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
等等，你還沒裝備念珠。
身為十字軍，必須時刻隨身帶著念珠。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Come back and take
the test after you
have a Rosary.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
有了念珠，再回來接受考驗吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
For the battle test, please prepare one ^3355FFHoly water^000000.
I told you just to purify the candidates.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
參加實戰考核，請準備1瓶^3355FF聖水^000000。
我說過，這是用來淨化考生的。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Get prepares and come back to here.
I will wait for you.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
準備好再來。
我會等你。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Then, I'll start
the test. You will
be purified with the
Holy Water you prepared.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
那麼，開始考核。
先用你帶來的聖水為你淨化。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
...............

[Bliant Piyord]
Let's begin.
Go and enter
the waiting room.
Defeat the monsters
that appear in
the 4 stages.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
開始吧。
請進入候考室。
擊敗四個階段中出現的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Prepare 1 ^3355FFHoly Water^000000 to take the battle test. As I've said, it will be used to purify you prior to taking the test.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
參加實戰考核，請準備1瓶^3355FF聖水^000000。
之前說過，考核前會用它為你淨化。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Come back and take
the test after you
have prepared
1 Holy Water.
I shall be
waiting.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
準備好1瓶聖水，再回來接受考驗。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Go talk to our
leader inside.
We welcome you into
the ranks of those
preparing for the
coming Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
去裡面找我們的首領談談。
歡迎你加入我們的行列，共同為即將到來的聖戰做準備。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
It's not your turn
to take my test yet.
Come back after taking
all the other tests.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
還沒輪到你接受我的考驗。
先完成其他所有考驗，再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
I'll see you soon.
May Odin's blessings
be with you.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
回頭見。
願奧丁的祝福與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
You will take
the last test here.
If you are ready for
the test, enter the
waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
歡迎。
最後一項考驗就在這裡進行。
準備好了，就進入候考室吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Only one person can take the test at a time. If someone else is already testing, please wait until the testing area is made available once again.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
每次只能有一人參加考核。
如果有人正在考試，請等考場空出來。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Each person will get 4 minutes to complete the test. If you wish to leave in the middle of the test, please disconnect from the game.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
每人有4分鐘完成考核。
如果想中途退出，請斷開遊戲連線。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Go forth and defeat all
the monsters that appear.
You will not pass if any
are remaining.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
去擊敗所有出現的魔物。
只要還有一隻留下，就無法通過。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
You will be given
4 minutes. Go forth
and do your best...
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩特·皮約德]
你有4分鐘。
去吧，全力以赴...
